messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: SLA breach detected for tenant=CoralPay — 95% of 'inference-latency' checks > 1.2s over last 5m, pages=118. Paging level: P1.
jana: ack. jumping on it. can someone grab impact? :hand: 
matthew: looking now — recent deploy? not seeing a deploy in the last hour.
raju: checking routing + dedicated capacity. could be a noisy KV-cache miss pattern.
elena: support says 12 customer requests complaining about timeouts on chat flows. ticket numbers: 75412, 75413.
ops-bot: autoscale events: +2 pods added 10m ago, no failures reported.
kai: I can take lead. jana can you own customer comms?
jana: yep, i'll draft a status note.
kai: ok. quick mitigation options: 1) silence noisy tenant low-severity pages, 2) temporary rate-limit retries at edge, 3) fallback to smaller model variant for CoralPay. Thoughts?
matthew: prefer 3 + 1. fallback reduces CPU/GPU contention quickly. can we patch routing to go to model-quantized-v1?
raju: topology note — CoralPay is pinned to dedicated pool D-GPU-36. fallback will need routing override to hosted-shared-quant. That will cost them different class, but keeps service alive.
elena: confirm if CoralPay SLA allows fallback to lower perf model? CX: they'd prefer uptime over higher quality.
jana: sending quick poll to account team.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: jana acknowledged. Pager duty: Kai assigned.
kai: executing plan: first silence noisy check to avoid paging fatigue. Doing: `/alerts mute --scope tenant=CoralPay --check=inference-latency --duration=1h --reason="mitigation in progress"`
matthew: while that's running, i'll open routing override: `PATCH /routing/v1/overrides` payload: `{ "tenant": "CoralPay", "route_to": "shared/quantized-v1", "ttl": 3600 }`
raju: before we route, confirm cache warming — quantized model cold-start may be slower first 2 requests. we should pre-warm by sending a warmup batch.
kai: good call. matthew can you kick warmup after routing?
matthew: routing applied. response: 200. starting warmup with 20 parallel requests. logs:
```
[warmup] 0/20 complete
[warmup] 7/20 complete
[warmup] 20/20 complete
```

kai: metrics: 2m after routing — P50 dropped from 1.5s -> 0.9s, P95 from 2.6s -> 1.1s. Pages should stop.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert noise suppressed for tenant=CoralPay.
jana: status update to customer sent: "We've routed to a fallback model to restore availability; we're working on a permanent fix and will follow up with post-incident notes."
elena: customer replied: thanks, they're okay with temporary fallback.
raju: root cause hypothesis: corrupt KV cache leading to repeated upstream DB reads causing tail latency. I see elevated DB read QPS from CoralPay namespace.
matthew: adding a debounce to the heartbeat check: decrease sensitivity for 10m for tenants with >50 alerts/min. We should avoid broad threshold changes though.
kai: agree. action items now: 
- mute tenant-specific pager (done)
- route CoralPay to shared/quantized-v1 (done)
- warm cache (done)
- create dashboard slice for CoralPay latency + DB QPS (in progress)
- post-incident: tune check to add transient-retry logic + add KV-cache health metric to alerts

jana: handing off to raju for post-mortem and follow-up. I'll close customer comms loop once PM approves final wording.
raju: starting a follow-up thread for RCA and alert surgery. putting tentative RCA owner: raju. ETA for RCA draft: EOD today.
incident-bot: :pager: Pager resolved — last page at 2112223529. Duration: 27m.
kai: marking incident as mitigated. moving to noisy-alert-sweep after this.
matthew: quick note for playbook: add `--exclude-tenant` flag to aggressive page rule so we can mute without losing backend anomaly detection.
elena: also add a dashboard alert for "cache miss rate" per tenant. that would've caught it earlier.
jana: done with customer note iteration — sending final.
raju: post-incident plan: create an internal runbook step: if tenant pages > 50 in 10m -> auto-mute pages and start routing fallback if pinned to dedicated and capacity < 70% used.
kai: I'll open a ticket with infra to investigate KV eviction pattern and consider guardrails on eviction policy.
matthew: creating a short-lived dashboard now: `dash: CoralPay-latency-troubleshooting` and pinning to oncall channel.
incident-bot: :pushpin: matthew pinned a message to #eng-oncall.
jana: thanks all. handing off to raju to drive RCA + alert surgery. please add any further notes in the RCA thread. :pray: 
raju: will do. logging link to follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7629
kai: +1. closing thread when RCA ticket created.
